_notes: Curated value types for Divi 5 (5.13.1) option-group families and for module-specific leaves the dump does not type. Paths come from research/divi5-schema (the union model, research/divi5/schema.md §3); this file only types them. build_schema5.py keeps a family entry only when the union declares that path (or the entry says "add" with its evidence), so fragments may be supersets. Evidence per family is in its _notes. Sources: JS = the field configs in visual-builder/build/module.js (component, features, option constants); D4 = the Divi 4 field (research/divi-schema) reached through the runtime D4->D5 conversion map; corpus = values in tests/fixtures/divi5 (Divi's converter, Divi AI and VB output). Leaf defaults: bp true, states [value, hover, sticky] (module.json features default {responsive, hover, sticky} = true). When a value's grammar is unclear the leaf is typed text or object rather than given invented options.

_types.color: hex (#rgb/#rrggbb/#rrggbbaa), rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla() (any case), transparent, or a $variable({"type":"color",...})$ global color reference
_types.enum: one of options (strings); with multiple: true, a list of options
_types.font-family: a font family name string, or a $variable({"type":"content",...})$ global font reference
_types.font-weight: 100..900 as a string/number, normal/bold/lighter/bolder, a Divi global-font weight token ("<Font>_weight", written by Divi AI), or a $variable reference
_types.gradient: a list of gradient stops [{position: number|string, color: color}]
_types.html: a string of HTML; innerContent rich text/code, stored JSON-escaped (\u003c...) in the block comment
_types.image: an image URL string (src/url leaves); id/alt/titleText are sibling leaves, not part of this value
_types.json: any JSON value (list, object or scalar); structure not validated
_types.length: a CSS length: number + unit (one of units when given), a bare 0, auto/none/inherit/initial, calc()/clamp()/min()/max()/var(), a $variable({"type":"content",...})$ number variable, or "" (unset)
_types.number: a number or a numeric string (unitless), or a $variable number reference
_types.object: a JSON object whose keys are not validated (opaque)
_types.radius: an object with keys from topLeft, topRight, bottomRight, bottomLeft (lengths) and sync (on/off); Divi's converter may also write a single length string
_types.spacing: an object with keys from top, right, bottom, left (lengths) and syncVertical, syncHorizontal (on/off)
_types.text: a string (plain text, CSS text, an id, a date, a CSS value Divi passes through verbatim)
_types.url: a URL string (absolute, relative, #anchor, mailto:, tel:) or a $variable dynamic-content reference

accent-color._notes: form accent color (checkbox/radio) - a single color

animation._notes: divi/animation (JS: all hover:false sticky:false; D4 animation_*; style/direction/repeat/speedCurve option constants JS Ca/Sa/wa/Aa = D4 lists). Durations/delays are ms lengths; intensities and startingOpacity are unitless/% numbers stored as strings.

speedCurve.note: animation uses CSS names (JS Aa, D4); the transition group's JS options (Bv) are camelCase; both accepted

attributes._notes: custom HTML attributes: a list of {id, name, value, targetElement} objects (corpus)

image.position.note: CSS background-position keywords after convertBackgroundPosition (corpus center, center top)

mask.style.note: a mask shape slug (D4 select-mask: layer-blob, arch, ..., wave; corpus diagonal, diagonal-bars, caret)

style.note: none or a Divi preset name (preset1..presetN); D4 presets_shadow/select_box_shadow, corpus none/preset1-6; number of presets not pinned

html._notes: divi/html (elementType select of HTML tag names, htmlBefore/After code)

elementType.note: an HTML tag name from Divi's VALID_HTML_ELEMENT_TYPES

inline-font._notes: fonts used inside rich text (D4 inline_fonts through convertInlineFont): a list of family names

interactions._notes: D5 interactions (triggers/effects list); structure not dumped

layout._notes: divi/layout (JS, D5-only; features hover:false sticky:false). display JS ly (converter writes block); flexDirection JS uy; grid options JS by/hy/vy/fy/gy. justifyContent/alignItems/alignContent/flexWrap build their options elsewhere -> text (CSS keywords). Grid templates/gaps are CSS text/lengths.

link._notes: divi/link (D4 link_option_url / link_option_url_new_window off|on; lightbox toggle)

loop._notes: divi/loop query builder (JS, D5-only): selects with dynamic options (post types, taxonomies) -> text; tag inputs / meta query -> json

meta._notes: divi/meta (forceVisible toggle, tocListHeading toggle for table-of-contents)

position._notes: divi/position (JS mode Mb default/relative/absolute/fixed; D4 positioning none/relative/absolute/fixed; origins are corner keywords like "top left" (corpus), D4 top_left)

scroll._notes: divi/scroll (D4 scroll_* motion fields through convertScroll): each effect value is {enable, viewport {bottom,end,start,top}, offset {start,mid,end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion.php convertScroll); *.enable toggles are declared, the rest of the effect object is open; motionTriggerStart D4 middle/top/bottom

blur.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

fade.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

horizontalMotion.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

rotating.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

scaling.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

verticalMotion.note: {enable, viewport: {bottom, end, start, top}, offset: {start, mid, end}} (AdvancedOptionConversion::convertScroll); open: keys other than the declared enable are accepted untyped

aspectRatio.note: JS divi/aspect-ratio: a ratio like 16/9 or auto

sticky._notes: divi/sticky (JS hover:false sticky:false; limits JS Bh = D4; position JS Fh topBottom, D4 top_bottom)

text._notes: divi/text: text.color = light/dark text scheme (D4 background_layout), orientation = alignment (D4 text_orientation); textShadow = divi/text-shadow
